rows.en: －　Corridor　－＝－　Yoh and Eiji are talking￥　　　　down the corridor　－
＊Eiji＊＠０９３＿００１Hey Yoh, listen to this!￥Talk about harsh!＝＠０９３＿００２Riko snapped at me, like,￥"Don't touch my shoulder so￥casually!"
＊Yoh＊＠０９３＿００３Ahh,￥yeah, Riko's pretty strict￥about that kind of thing.

＊Eiji＊＠０９３＿００４She's way too headstrong.＝＠０９３＿００５Only daughter of some fancy￥family, dad's a big shot in￥Project Elan, whatever.＝＠０９３＿００６That attitude really ticks me￥off. Cute face or not, with a￥personality like that...＝＠０９３＿００７I bet she's not scared of￥anything, huh?
＊Yoh＊＠０９３＿００８Well, I don't think her family￥has anything to do with it, but￥you might have a point.
－　The two of them wander off￥　　still chatting　－
－　?!　－＝－　Riko is peering down￥　　　　　　the corridor　－
What are you doing?
Mind if I get by...?
What are you doing?
Mind if I get by...?
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０１０Eeeeeek!!
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０１１Ahh, you scared me!￥Oh, it's just you.＝＠０９３＿０１２Don't startle me like that,￥geez!
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０１３Be more careful when you￥call out to people!!
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０１４I thought my heart￥was going to stop!!
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０１６Oh, sorry about that.￥But I'm not just standing here￥for no reason, you know!
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０１７Honestly!￥Be more careful when you￥call out to people!!
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０１８You startled me!!
Why are you so jumpy?
Don't yell at me!
Why are you so jumpy?
Don't yell at me!
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０１９H-how rude!￥I'm not jumpy at all!￥Don't treat me like a kid!
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０２０I'm not yelling!￥How rude!＝＠０９３＿０２１You're the one who￥suddenly got mad!!
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０２２Wh-when I tried to turn the￥corner, I saw something white￥and blurry floating there.
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０２３It was just a split second, so I￥didn't get a good look... but it￥seemed to be moving...
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０２４Hey...!￥What do you think that white￥thing was?
Maybe it was a ghost.
You must've imagined it.
Maybe it was a ghost.
You must've imagined it.
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０２５You think so too?￥There's a rumor that this area￥is haunted, you know.＝＠０９３＿０２６The ghost of someone who died in￥an accident wanders the halls￥every night...
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０２７You might not have heard,￥but this place has tons￥of scary stories.
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０２８You can only say that because￥you didn't see it!!
＊Riko＊＠０９３＿０２９There really, REALLY￥is something there!!￥I can tell!!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿００１Ugh, what do I do? I could take￥the long way back...
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿００２I-it's not like I'm scared￥or anything!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿００３I just don't like things I can't￥identify, or things I can't see￥clearly, that's all!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿００４I know!!￥Why don't you go￥chase it off for me?
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿００５You seem thick-skinned enough.￥Unlike delicate little me, you'd￥be fine if it possessed you!!
You're kidding, right?
Fine, if I have to.
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿００６That's so unmanly!￥Don't you have any urge￥to protect a lady?
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿００７Ugh!￥Quit whining and￥just go already!!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿００８Oh! You've got a pretty￥sweet side after all!￥I'm impressed!!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿００９See, I knew I was￥a good judge of character!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０１０You look tough enough. Unlike￥delicate little me, you'd be￥fine if it possessed you!!
You're kidding, right?
Fine, if I have to.
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０１１Does this sound like a joke?＝＠０９４＿０１２Come on, I'm in trouble here, so￥you could help me out a little,￥couldn't you?!＝＠０９４＿０１３Don't you have any compassion?
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０１４Ugh!￥Quit whining and￥just go already!!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０１５Oh! You've got a pretty￥sweet side after all!￥I'm impressed!!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０１６See, I knew I was￥a good judge of character!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０１７Even if something happens to￥you, don't worry!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０１８I'll make sure to carry your￥bones to Elan, so go fight with￥no regrets!!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０１９W-wait!￥I'm coming too after all!!
＊＊－　； and Riko walk up to￥　　　the "white thing"　－
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０２１N-no way... don't tell me...
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０２２It's just a towel hanging￥there...?￥You've got to be kidding me!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０２３I can't believe this!!￥What is this?! How misleading!!
I can't believe YOU!
It IS pretty misleading.
I can't believe YOU!
It IS pretty misleading.
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０２４You don't have to get￥so mad!!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０２５It really looked like a￥ghost, okay?!
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０２６Right! Exactly!￥Honestly, who'd pull a prank￥like this here?
＊Riko＊＠０９４＿０２７If it was one of the candidates,￥they're going to pay!
＊Riko＊＠０９５＿００１Oh, and sorry for holding￥you up, too!
＊Riko＊＠０９５＿００２But I never said "help me" to￥you, not even once!＝＠０９５＿００３So this was all your own￥idea, wasn't it?
＊Riko＊...｝￥＠０９５＿００４What's with that look?
＊Riko＊＠０９５＿００５Aren't you thrilled to get to￥talk with me this much?!
Yes, yes, I'm thrilled.
No, not really...
Yes, yes, I'm thrilled.
No, not really...
＊Riko＊＠０９５＿００６What kind of lame￥answer is that?!
＊Riko＊＠０９５＿００７If you take me lightly,￥you'll regret it later!!
＊Riko＊＠０９５＿００８What did you say?!
＊Riko＊＠０９５＿００９You can't even be honest￥about how you feel...
＊Riko＊＠０９５＿０１０Ugh, you're hopeless!＝＠０９５＿０１１I was an idiot to think better￥of you even once!
＊Riko＊＠０９５＿０１２But I didn't ask you to do￥any of this, right?
＊Riko＊＠０９５＿０１３So don't you dare think I owe￥you one, got it?!
＊Riko＊＠０９５＿０１４Well, see ya!!
